name: objekte/kraft_fuehler
note: Все четыре лучше генерировать в одном чате подряд, чтобы рамка и стиль совпали.
where: Вступление, значок перед каждой загадкой и финал — сила «Leucht-Fühler»
text:
Use the attached images as the exact reference for characters and style. Same children's picture-book style. Plain warm white background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no stars. Every item clearly separated from the others with empty space around it, so it can be cut out. Soft hand-painted picture-book look (watercolor and colored pencil) like the attached images – NOT flat vector clip-art, no glossy 3D look.
A round medallion, centered, filling about 85% of the picture: a circular picture with a thin golden rim, inside a deep night-blue background with a few tiny soft sparkles. In the medallion, a close-up (head and upper body) of the SAME little green caterpillar as on the attached sheets – same face, same colours, same small blue cape. No text, no letters, no numbers. Outside the medallion only the plain background. All four medallions of this set must have the same size, rim and style. Her two antennae glow brightly: the little balls at the tips shine warm golden like tiny lanterns and cast a soft golden light, a few golden sparks float around them. She looks up at them, amazed and proud.
